finding: The admitted dry-run gate shows the earlier refusals were a test-side CRD readiness race (admitted after 2.01 s). PrepareStart then succeeded (2.81 s, including a full re-proof because the cached proof had expired during the gate). ReadyStart ran three per-call process rechecks (about 50 limiter-bound calls, 2.15 s) and was denied 47 ms before the original 5-second bound. Each connector start check re-proves the whole process, which cannot fit at 20 QPS; this motivated ADR-173.
